summary: M3.S2 Publishing Center: full backend + frontend validation. All 4 pytest backend tests PASS (POST default true, POST false persists, PATCH toggle, /api/cloud/search filter). All 14 frontend E2E assertions PASS via Playwright (publishing-center visible, toggle default ON, share-disabled-hint on new form, toggle->save->reopen persists OFF, immobilcloud-off-notice visible, share buttons WA/FB/Email/Copy with correct hrefs, public URL /api/p/{slug}/{pid}, Copiato! after copy, re-enabling and saving persists True).

issues: React warning: 'value prop on input should not be null' (uncritical, comes from one of the controlled inputs receiving null e.g. reference_code/seller_client_id when hydrated). Not blocking M3.S2 but worth tidying with `value ?? ''`.

action_items: Optional: fix React 'value should not be null' warning on PropertyFormPage by guarding controlled inputs with `value={x ?? ''}` (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: PATCH endpoint correctly skips fields where v is None (good for partial updates) and special-cases NULLABLE_FIELDS — the boolean toggle path works because Pydantic exclude_unset=True respects the actually-sent field.
public_portal._base_filter uses {'$ne': False} so legacy docs without the field still appear in /api/cloud/search — correct behavior for backward compatibility.
PublishingCenter.jsx correctly disables share buttons when no propertyId yet and shows hint; share URLs are properly URL-encoded; copy-to-clipboard uses navigator.clipboard and falls back silently.
PropertyFormPage hydrates form.is_listed_on_immobilcloud from the API response correctly via spread of empty + d.
seed_data_creation: Test properties created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up at end of each test (backend) and via DELETE call after the FE E2E run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M3.S2 Publishing Center fully validated. Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_publishing_center_m3s2.py. The super admin's active agency slug at test time was 'test-omnia-agency-abc700'. Public share URL pattern confirmed: {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/p/{agency_slug}/{property_id}. /api/cloud/search correctly filters is_listed_on_immobilcloud != False.
rca of the issue: No issues. Single non-blocking React console warning about a controlled input receiving null value (pre-existing in PropertyFormPage, unrelated to M3.S2).
